four_core_reduction.statement: Conditional on the stated defect/fan premises, an n=18,T=95 normalized arrangement with exactly four finite multiple points has multiplicities only 3333, 3334, 3335, 3344, or 3444. For four noncollinear cores with D2>=5, at least three cores are extreme, so at most one core may be saturated. The protected q=4 finite replay then excludes profiles 3335, 3344, and 3444, leaving only 3333 and 3334.
